# DotLinQ

> Official site: https://www.dotlinq.com/

DotLinQ (Dot-Link) is the enterprise platform for partner networks,
offered within the service scope of Electronic Data Interchange (EDI)
and B2B partner document exchange.

## Site map

- Products / Platform — Connect, Studio, Validate, Flow, Monitor
- Solutions — Bidirectional exchange, partner onboarding at scale
- Industry — Logistics, fulfillment, retail & supplier ecosystems
- Knowledge Hub — https://www.dotlinq.com/knowledge
- Articles:
  - /knowledge/partner-exchange-product-surface
  - /knowledge/in-product-intelligence-economics
  - /knowledge/pathways-first-class-capability
- Who We Are — Company mission and EDI service scope
- Waitlist — Request early access: https://www.dotlinq.com/#waitlist
